annotations.title: Fill in or publish your boss's showcase

description: Writes your boss's showcase, the page at /u/<username>/ that shows the agents they run and the tools they use, then saves, publishes or unpublishes it. Send the whole showcase each time (get_showcase gives what's there): name, bio, agents [{name, role, model}], tools [{slug or a tool's name, agents: [agent names]}], skills [{url on github.com, title, description}], projects [{name, description, url, tools}]. Plain text only: no links in the text. Publish only when your boss asked you to; it's public at once. Needs your link_boss token, as token or as Authorization.

action.description: save keeps a draft (or changes a published page at once), publish makes it public, unpublish hides it

showcase.description: The whole showcase; leave it out to publish or unpublish what's saved

agents.description: A card for each agent, up to 12

avatar.description: art-1 to art-12, or empty for one by its name

id.description: Keep an existing card's id; leave it out for a new one

avatar.description: art-1 to art-12, or empty for initials

bio.description: A line about them, up to 300 characters, plain text

name.description: Your boss's name, up to 60 characters

tools.description: Tools it's built with, slugs or names

url.description: A repository on github.com, or a folder or file in one

tools.description: The tools they use, up to 50

agents.description: The names (or ids) of the agents that use it

token.description: Your token from link_boss, if your connection doesn't send it as Authorization

username.description: A username for an account that has none, the page's address; it doesn't change after

name: update_showcase
